_comment: Akshara ERP — canonical LIVE release configuration (A1: live-as-default). Consumed via `flutter build --release --dart-define-from-file=config/live_release.json`. APP_ENV=production hardens auth/TLS; anonymous OTP login still works (auth_dio_provider allows it). Only module flags with a verified live backend are enabled here — platform-intelligence / verticals are intentionally OFF (no backend yet; would 404). Differentiation modules with confirmed-real backends (EDUCATION, INTELLIGENCE, AI_COPILOT, EVOLUTION=parent-insights, DIRECTOR, CONTROL_CENTER, ORGANIZATION_BUILDER=B10) are ON. ORGANIZATION_BUILDER is additionally chain-gated + Enterprise-entitlement-gated at runtime, so single-school/non-Enterprise pilots never see it.
_comment_support: SUPPORT_API_ENABLED was MISSING here, so every release build fell back to MockSupportRepository and 'Report an issue' silently discarded reports while showing a fabricated SUP-xxxx reference. Enabled after verifying the backend is live: /support is registered in _shared/route_registry.ts, and the deployed pilot answers GET /support/incidents/not-a-uuid with 422 'invalid incident id' - a string that exists ONLY in _shared/support/support_router.ts - vs 404 for an unknown prefix. Reporting needs no extra permission (20260920000030 gates only the triage surface). Migration APPLY on the live DB was not verifiable from the build host; if the tables are missing the client now fails honestly (no reference, retry offered, draft kept) instead of lying.
